collection_protocol: Predeclared 3/2 E515 SHA256 rounds; randomized order; warmup then calibration-only policy gate, then complete holdouts
limitations: Exploratory single-host CPU microbenchmark with synthetic rewards. The E515 pilot informed the predeclared 3/2 multiplier; E516 is not independent of that design choice. Calibration and holdouts share host; unknown contention/thermal state; randomization does not guarantee independent trials; no policy overhead measured; self-reported hashes and provenance do not authenticate the measurements.
nominal_source: rounded median of E516 calibration timings only
record_note: Compact derivative of original measurement-time manifest; original per-run orders and output digests not included. Original trace and catalog bytes retained.
reward_source: E515 frozen arbitrary synthetic rewards, not economic value
